component.name: aws2-transcribe
component.title: AWS Transcribe
component.description: Transcribe speech in audio and video files in S3 to text with Amazon Transcribe, and manage its custom vocabularies, vocabulary filters and language models.
component.label: cloud,messaging

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It is required, as no header replaces it: a producer without an operation fails the exchange.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a StartTranscriptionJobRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

protocol.deprecationNote: Not used: nothing reads this option when the Transcribe client is built
protocol.description: This option has no effect: the Transcribe client uses HTTPS, or the scheme of uriEndpointOverride when overrideEndpoint is true. For the protocol of the proxy, use proxyProtocol. Deprecation note: Not used: nothing reads this option when the Transcribe client is built

proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon Transcribe, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the aws.region system property or the AWS_REGION environment variable is used, and else the default region provider chain of the AWS SDK.

transcribeClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.transcribe.TranscribeClient. When this option is set, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The endpoint does not close this client, but the component closes a client that is set on the component when the component stops.

trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of Amazon Transcribe trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. If not set, the aws.accessKeyId system property or the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID environment variable is used. It is required, unless transcribeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

proxyPassword.label: security
proxyPassword.description: The password for the proxy. It is not used: the Transcribe client that the component builds does not authenticate to the proxy.

proxyUsername.label: security
proxyUsername.description: The user name for the proxy. It is not used: the Transcribe client that the component builds does not authenticate to the proxy.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. If not set, the aws.secretKey system property or the AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variable is used. It is required, unless transcribeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

CamelAwsTranscribeTranscriptionJobName.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeTranscriptionJobName.description: The name of the transcription job, for startTranscriptionJob, getTranscriptionJob and deleteTranscriptionJob. It must be unique in the AWS account.

CamelAwsTranscribeLanguageCode.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeLanguageCode.description: The language code of the audio, such as en-US, for startTranscriptionJob, startMedicalTranscriptionJob, createVocabulary, updateVocabulary, createMedicalVocabulary, updateMedicalVocabulary, createVocabularyFilter and createLanguageModel. Medical transcription supports only en-US.

CamelAwsTranscribeMediaFormat.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeMediaFormat.description: The format of the media file, such as mp3, wav or flac, for startTranscriptionJob and startMedicalTranscriptionJob. If not set, Amazon Transcribe detects the format.

CamelAwsTranscribeMediaUri.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeMediaUri.description: The S3 location of the media file to transcribe, such as s3://my-bucket/audio.mp3, for startTranscriptionJob and startMedicalTranscriptionJob. Amazon Transcribe reads the file from S3, so the message body is not used.

CamelAwsTranscribeJobNameContains.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeJobNameContains.description: A text that the names must contain, without regard to case, to filter the jobs of listTranscriptionJobs and listMedicalTranscriptionJobs, and the items of listVocabularyFilters, listLanguageModels and listMedicalVocabularies. listVocabularies does not read it.

CamelAwsTranscribeStatus.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeStatus.description: The status to filter the list by: a job status such as QUEUED, IN_PROGRESS, FAILED or COMPLETED for listTranscriptionJobs and listMedicalTranscriptionJobs, a vocabulary state such as PENDING, READY or FAILED for listVocabularies and listMedicalVocabularies, or a model status such as IN_PROGRESS, FAILED or COMPLETED for listLanguageModels. If not set, every status is listed.

CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyName.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyName.description: The name of the custom vocabulary, for createVocabulary, getVocabulary, updateVocabulary and deleteVocabulary, or of the custom medical vocabulary, for createMedicalVocabulary, getMedicalVocabulary, updateMedicalVocabulary and deleteMedicalVocabulary. The transcription jobs do not read it.

CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyFilterName.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyFilterName.description: The name of the custom vocabulary filter, for createVocabularyFilter, getVocabularyFilter, updateVocabularyFilter and deleteVocabularyFilter. The transcription jobs do not read it.

CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyPhrases.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyPhrases.description: The phrases of the custom vocabulary, for createVocabulary and updateVocabulary, or the words of the vocabulary filter, for createVocabularyFilter and updateVocabularyFilter, as a List of String, or as a String for a single phrase. Use it or the CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyFileUri header, not both.

CamelAwsTranscribeLanguageModelName.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeLanguageModelName.description: The name of the custom language model, for createLanguageModel, describeLanguageModel and deleteLanguageModel. The transcription jobs do not read it.

CamelAwsTranscribeMedicalTranscriptionJo.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeMedicalTranscriptionJo.description: The name of the medical transcription job, for startMedicalTranscriptionJob, getMedicalTranscriptionJob and deleteMedicalTranscriptionJob. It must be unique in the AWS account.

CamelAwsTranscribeResourceArn.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeResourceArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource, such as a transcription job, a vocabulary or a language model, for tagResource, untagResource and listTagsForResource.

CamelAwsTranscribeTags.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeTags.description: The tags that tagResource adds to the resource, as a Map of tag key to tag value.

CamelAwsTranscribeTagKeys.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeTagKeys.description: The keys of the tags that untagResource removes from the resource, as a List of String.

CamelAwsTranscribeMaxResults.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeMaxResults.description: The maximum number of items in one page of the result, for listVocabularyFilters, listLanguageModels, listMedicalVocabularies and listMedicalTranscriptionJobs. If not set, Amazon Transcribe returns at most 5. listTranscriptionJobs and listVocabularies do not read it.

CamelAwsTranscribeNextToken.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeNextToken.description: The NextToken of the previous response of the same list operation, to get the next page, for listVocabularyFilters, listLanguageModels, listMedicalVocabularies and listMedicalTranscriptionJobs. listTranscriptionJobs and listVocabularies do not read it.

CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyFileUri.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeVocabularyFileUri.description: The S3 location of the text file with the terms of the vocabulary, for createVocabulary, updateVocabulary, createMedicalVocabulary and updateMedicalVocabulary, or with the words of the filter, for createVocabularyFilter and updateVocabularyFilter.

CamelAwsTranscribeBaseModelName.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeBaseModelName.description: The base model of the custom language model, for createLanguageModel: NarrowBand for audio with a sample rate below 16,000 Hz, or WideBand for 16,000 Hz and above.

CamelAwsTranscribeInputDataS3Uri.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeInputDataS3Uri.description: The S3 location of the training data of the custom language model, for createLanguageModel. It is used together with the CamelAwsTranscribeDataAccessRoleArn header.

CamelAwsTranscribeDataAccessRoleArn.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeDataAccessRoleArn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Amazon Transcribe uses to read the training data, for createLanguageModel, or the file of the vocabulary filter, for createVocabularyFilter and updateVocabularyFilter.

CamelAwsTranscribeOutputBucketName.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeOutputBucketName.description: The S3 bucket that startMedicalTranscriptionJob writes the transcript to. startTranscriptionJob does not read it: Amazon Transcribe then keeps the transcript in a bucket of its own, at the URI that getTranscriptionJob gives.

CamelAwsTranscribeSpecialty.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeSpecialty.description: The medical specialty of the audio, for startMedicalTranscriptionJob, such as PRIMARYCARE.

CamelAwsTranscribeType.label: producer
CamelAwsTranscribeType.description: The type of the audio, for startMedicalTranscriptionJob: CONVERSATION for a conversation between people, or DICTATION for a single speaker.

producerIn.description: Not used: AWS reads the audio from S3, at the URI in the CamelAwsTranscribeMediaUri header, and the other inputs come from headers too, such as the job name in CamelAwsTranscribeTranscriptionJobName. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a StartTranscriptionJobRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the StartTranscriptionJobResponse of startTranscriptionJob. The transcript is not in the body: the job writes it to S3, at the URI that getTranscriptionJob gives

label.description: A logical name of the endpoint, which you choose freely. The producer does not use it: the job, vocabulary, filter or model to act on is given in headers.
